cases.headline: Small long: the stock is recovering from a big gap down and pushing to a new day high, but it faces resistance just above.
cases.bull:
**Bull case (long MUTHOOTFIN):** The stock gapped down 3.78% (open 2519 vs prev close 2618), but it has held up. The first bar spiked to a low of 2485.8, then closed at 2532.5, a 46.7-point rejection of the lows. Since then the lows have risen (2523.2, 2522.6, 2530.3). Price is 2543, at the day high and above VWAP (2532.88). Relative volume is 4.07 and the index is up 0.28%.

**Entry:** On a break and hold above 2544.27, which is just 1.3 points above the last close. Don't chase beyond roughly 2550.

**Stop:** The rule-based stop at 2485.8 is 58 points away, about 2.5 ATR. That's too wide. I'd use a tighter stop below the 09:25-09:30 base, around 2520, just under VWAP and the 2522.6 low. That's about 24 points of risk, so roughly 20 shares at Rs 500 risk.

**Target:** The rule target of 2661 is unrealistic intraday. It would need about 117 points, above prev close. A realistic target is 2575-2590, about 1.3-2R, near one day's ATR range.

**Wrong if:** Price loses VWAP and 2520 on volume. Also note that the 09:30 bar's volume is only 10,960, thin on the breakout, and the stock is below its 20-day average (2636) and yesterday's low (2553.8), which is overhead resistance.
cases.bear:
Rebuttal: The Bull's "rejection" is one opening bar, and the 147k volume was spent there. Volume then fell to 65.8k, 42.4k and 10,960 on the 09:30 bar, which is about 7% of the first bar. The new high at 2543 came on almost no volume, and the Bull concedes this. The relvol of 4.07 is inflated by that first bar. Rising lows are only 7 to 10 points apart, which is under half an ATR (22.8), so that is drift, not structure. The index is up just 0.28%, which is no real tailwind.

Case for short or out: the stock gapped down 3.78%. Yesterday's low of 2553.8 is only 10.8 points above, and the 20-day average (2636) and prev close (2618) sit above that. Any long has to push into that supply. A 2544.27 trigger is 1.3 points from the last price, so it is essentially noise and the entry is a coin flip. Costs are about a quarter of risk, so a 24-point stop with a 2575 target is not clean.

A short only works on failure: trigger below 2522 (under the 2522.6 base low and VWAP). Stop 2545, which is 23 points. Target 2490, near the opening low, about 1.4R. That edge is marginal, so my honest lean is to stay out until a real move shows volume.

judge.title: MUTHOOTFIN: gap-down reversal long on a break of 2545, tight stop under the base
judge.text: The stock opened 3.78% lower at 2519 vs 2618 and was sold to 2485.8. The first bar then closed at 2532.5, and price now sits at the day high of 2543, above VWAP (2532.88), with relvol at 4.07x and the index up 0.28%. The Bear is right on two points: the 09:30 push came on only 10,960 shares, and yesterday's low of 2553.8 is just 10.8 points overhead. So the rule plan's 58-point stop and 2661 target are unrealistic. I use a tight stop at 2521, under the 2522.6 base low and VWAP, which risks 24 points. The target is 2582, 37 points or about 1.5x risk, inside a normal intraday range given the 5-minute ATR of 22.8. My own record leans toward taking this kind of trade: in two similar gap-down recoveries I stayed out, and the rule plan made +0.63R and +0.67R. That is only 14 calls, so weak evidence. Conviction stays at 2 because of the thin breakout volume and the supply overhead.

cases.headline: TECHM turned an early dip into a 2.5% rally and is holding near the top; buy a small long only if it breaks 1761.
cases.bull:
**Bull case (long TECHM):** The stock gapped down 0.44% (open 1715.5 vs prev close 1723.0), then rallied 2.54% in the first bar, 1715.2 to 1753.4. It has held that gain: the three bars after the opening one all have lows at or above 1745.4 and closes between 1755.6 and 1759.0. Last is 1759.0, just above VWAP at 1755.58, and the opening range high is 1759.9. Relative volume of 3.6x says the move has real participation, and the index is up 0.28%. Prior-day high of 1735.9 is now well below price, which is a clean breakout.

**Entry:** A 5-minute close above 1760.8, the trigger, ideally with volume above the last bar's thin 46,900.

**Stop:** The rule's stop at 1715.2 is 45 points away, roughly 2.9x ATR. That's too wide. I'd use about 1745, under the 09:20 low and VWAP, which is about 15 points of risk, or 1 ATR. Rs 500 buys about 33 shares.

**Target:** The rule's 1851.94 is unrealistic. Realistic is about 1785, near the 20-day average of 1785.9, which is roughly 1.6R.

**Wrong if:** price closes below VWAP or 1745, or the breakout fails on weak volume. Honestly, the move is already extended, so the edge is marginal.
cases.bear:
Rebuttals: The Bull's own concession matters most. The move is extended: price rose 43.8 points (2.5%) in one bar, roughly 2.8x ATR of 15.9, and the opening range is that same bar plus three more, so "breakout" is just price sitting at the top of a 44-point range. The "held gain" is only 15 minutes. Volume is fading: 190,790 at 09:25, then 46,900 at 09:30, a quarter of the prior bar. Relative volume of 3.6x is mostly the opening bar. The index is up just 0.28%, which is no strong tailwind. Bull's 1745 stop is below VWAP but the 09:20 low is 1745.4, so it's thin. The 1785.9 target hits the 20-day average, a likely resistance, and the long's reward-to-risk of 1.6R is eaten by costs at about 0.25R.

Short case: weak. Price is only 3.4 points above VWAP, and the last bar made a lower high (1759.0 vs 1759.9) on thin volume. But there's no confirmed failure yet.

Short trigger: 5-minute close below 1752 (under VWAP and the 09:25 low of 1753.6). Stop: 1761, about 9 points. Target: 1735.9 (yesterday's high), 16 points, ~1.8R. Otherwise, stay out. Preferred call: no trade until one of those triggers prints.

judge.title: TECHM: modest long on an opening-range break, with a tight stop
judge.text: Price recovered from a 0.44% gap down to a 2.54% gain and has held a tight 1753–1760 band for three bars. The lows are at or above 1745.4, last is 1759.0 above VWAP 1755.58, relative volume is 3.6x and the index is up 0.28%, so the Bull's continuation case is real. The Bear's points also stand: the first bar ran about 2.8x ATR (15.9), volume fell from 190,790 to 46,900, and the 20-day average at 1785.9 sits overhead. So I am rejecting the rule plan's 45-point stop and its 1851.94 target. Instead I go long at 1761 with a stop at 1746, below the 09:20 low and VWAP (15 points, about 1 ATR), and a target of 1786 at the 20-day average (about 1.67R). Conviction stays at 2 because the room left after costs is thin, but the weight of evidence favours a modest long: the scanner's filled plans averaged +0.32R (n=11), and my refusals of similar high-volume long setups left gains on the table.

cases.headline: Apollo Hospitals is pushing to new day highs on heavy volume; buy only if it clears 9030, with a stop just under VWAP.
cases.bull:
Case for long, kept honest: APOLLOHOSP gapped up 1.07% over yesterday's high (open 8831.5 vs prev_hi 8810, prev_close 8738), then rose every bar. It last printed 9019.5, above VWAP 8973.3, with relvol 3.46 and the index up 0.28%. The 09:30 bar closed at its high area (9025 high, 9019.5 close), and the 20DMA of 8365 shows a strong trend.

Entry: the scanner's 9024.01 trigger, just above day high 9025, is a reasonable buy-stop. Better is a pullback toward 8975-8990 (VWAP/prior bar lows) if it holds.

Stop: the scanner's 8831.5 is the OR low, 192 points away. That is about 2.9x ATR5 (66.5). At Rs 500 risk it allows only ~2 shares, so costs would hurt. I'd use a tighter stop below VWAP, ~8960 (about 64 points, roughly 1 ATR), giving ~7 shares.

Target: the scanner's 9409 is +385, which is unrealistic intraday. Aim for 9100-9150 (+1.2 to 2 ATR), with partial profits there.

Wrong if: price closes a 5-minute bar below VWAP (~8973), or it loses 8960 on rising volume. The move is already 2.1% extended, so chasing is a risk.
cases.bear:
Rebuttal: The Bull's "rose every bar" is true, but the opening range is only four bars old, so or_hi 9015 is barely a range. The 09:30 bar's volume fell to 28,452 from 42,762, and its close (9019.5) sits below the 9025 high. The breakout is just 0.05% above or_hi, which is noise against ATR5 of 66.5. The 20DMA of 8365 shows the stock is 7.8% extended, which argues for mean reversion as much as trend. The Bull's 8960 stop is only about 13 points below VWAP 8973, so a routine pullback hits it. The target of 9100-9150 is about 1.2 to 2 ATR with no pullback room.

Bear case: price is 46 points (0.5%) above VWAP after a 2.1% run in 20 minutes, and volume is fading. A failed push above 9025 is plausible.

Short idea, low conviction: trigger on a 5-minute close below 8990 (under the 09:30 low of 8988). Stop 9030, about 40 points. Target 8935, near the 09:20 bar's mid-range, about 55 points, for roughly 1.4R. That edge is thin after costs.

Honest call: stay out. The long is chasing, the short has no confirmation, and a marginal edge is a loss.

judge.title: APOLLOHOSP: gap-and-go long above 9025, stop under VWAP
judge.text: The deciding facts favour the long. The stock opened at 8831.5, above yesterday's high of 8810. Every 5-minute bar since then has made a higher high, up to 9025. Volume is 3.46x normal, price (9019.5) is 46 points above VWAP (8973.3), and the index is up 0.28%, so the move is not fighting the market. The Bear is right that the scanner's stop at 8831.5 is too wide (192 points, 2.9x ATR) and that the 09:30 bar's volume slipped to 28k from 43k, so I won't buy here. I'll buy on a trade at 9030, above the 9025 high, with the stop at 8965, just under VWAP: that is 65 points, about 1 ATR, or roughly 7 shares at Rs 500 risk. The target is 9135, 105 points (1.6R), which a 2.1% opening drive can plausibly add. My record has weak support at n=14: refused rule trades averaged +0.09R, and in the similar strong-relvol longs my levels made about +1.3R. That, plus the 7.8% stretch above the 20DMA (8365), keeps conviction at 3 rather than higher.

cases.headline: Coal India gave up its opening gain on heavy volume; short it only if it breaks below today's 388 low.
cases.bull:
Honest case for a long is thin, and I'd say so up front. The scanner's short is the trend-aligned trade: open 394.0 was the day high, price fell to 388.0 (-1.28%), below VWAP 389.42, and 20DMA 398.56 sits far above.

The bull case is a mean-reversion bounce. The 09:25 bar hit the OR low of 388.0 on 512k volume (relvol 3.46) but the 09:30 bar closed at 388.95, above that low, with a tiny 18k volume. Price is only 0.24% above the low, and the index is up 0.28%. Yesterday's low of 386.55 is nearby support, so a long could use a tight stop.

Entry: only on a reclaim of VWAP, say a 5-minute close above 389.45, ideally 389.6. Stop: 387.8, just under the OR low and the 388.0 flush, about 1.8 risk, roughly 0.9 ATR. Target: 392.0-393.0, near the prior close of 391.5 and short of the 394 OR high. That is about 2.5-3.5 points of reward, roughly 1.5R, before costs that eat a quarter of the risk.

Proved wrong: any close below 388.0, or rejection at VWAP. Only one 5-minute bar of stabilization exists, so I'd call this low-conviction and probably a pass.
cases.bear:
Rebuttals: The Bull's bounce rests on one 09:30 bar closing at 388.95 on 17,982 shares. That is a stub, not stabilization, and it is almost certainly an incomplete bar. Its tiny volume proves nothing against 512k on the flush. The index up 0.28% is minor against COALINDIA's -1.28%, so relative weakness persists. Yesterday's low of 386.55 is only 1.45 below the OR low, so it's a magnet for continuation, not much support. The long target of 392-393 needs a VWAP reclaim first, and price sits only 0.47 under VWAP, so a reclaim is noise-level.

Short case: open 394.0 equals the day high, three straight lower bars, price below VWAP 389.42, 20DMA 398.56 far overhead, and volume peaked at the break (relvol 3.46).

Honest problem: the scanner's plan is poor. Trigger 387.81, stop 393.77 is 5.96 risk, about 3 ATR, and target 375.88 is 12 points away, unrealistic given the prior range. Price is already near the lows, so chasing risks a bounce.

My trade: short on a 5-minute close below 387.8. Stop 390.2 (about 2.4 risk, above VWAP). Target 385.4, about 1R, just under yesterday's low of 386.55. That is marginal after costs, so staying out without a clean break is acceptable.

judge.title: COALINDIA: small short on a break of the 388 opening-range low, with a tighter stop than the scanner's
judge.text: The case for weakness is concrete. COALINDIA opened at the day high of 394.0, about 0.64% above the 391.5 close. It then fell to 388.0, down 1.28%, on 3.46x relative volume, while the index rose 0.28%. Price at 388.95 sits under VWAP 389.42 and far below the 20DMA of 398.56. The Bull's bounce rests on one 18k-share stub bar, which I discount, as the Bear argued. I reject the scanner's levels: a 5.96-point stop (about 3 ATR) and a 375.88 target are not realistic for the day's range. I also reject the Bear's 1R target, which costs would largely erase. Instead I short a break of 387.8 with a stop at 389.7, just above VWAP (1.9 points of risk), and a 384.2 target (about 1.9R). Conviction is only 2 because yesterday's low of 386.55 sits 1.25 points under the trigger as possible support, and price is already extended after a 1.28% drop in 15 minutes. My record is a small sample (n=14 calls, 4 trades taken), but it leans toward acting on similar shorts: refused rule trades averaged +0.09R, and the shorts I took scored well.

cases.headline: SBIN is slipping after a failed opening pop, but the selling is fading too fast to bet on, so we stay out.
cases.bull:
Honest case for a long is thin, and I'd say so up front.

The argument: SBIN gapped up 0.79% (open 1144 vs prev close 1135), sits far above its 20-DMA (1012.65), and relvol of 6.05 shows real participation. Price has held above yesterday's high (1142.65) for most of the session, and the last bar's low of 1141.0 is only marginally below it. Index is down just 0.21%, so the stock is not being dragged.

Entry: only on a reclaim, not a bounce attempt now. I'd want a 5-minute close above VWAP (1146.24), ideally ~1147, which shows buyers absorbing the 09:25-09:30 selling. Stop: below the day low, 1140.5, about 6.5 risk, roughly one ATR (5.84). Target: 1150.55 (OR high/day high), about 3.5 reward, which is under 1R. A breakout above 1150.55 would give about 1155-1158, but that's speculative.

Weaknesses: volume collapsed (2.8M to 135k), the bars are lower highs, and the close is at the day low. Costs of about 0.25R make the reward/risk poor.

Proves me wrong: any close below 1141, which is the setup failing.
cases.bear:
Rebuttals: The gap-up and 20-DMA extension (1012.65) are daily context, not intraday edge, and a 12.7% stretch invites mean reversion. Relvol of 6.05 is front-loaded: volume fell from 2.8M to 135k, so participation is leaving, not building. "Holding above yesterday's high" is stale; 1141.0 is now below 1142.65. The index is down 0.21%, which supports the short, not the long. The Bull's own long target (1150.55) is under 1R, so he concedes the trade fails after costs.

Bear case: the opening spike to 1150.55 was rejected, with lower highs (1150.55, 1150.15, 1148.25, 1143.5) and a close on the low at 1141.0. Price is 5.2 below VWAP (about 0.9 ATR). Honest weaknesses: only four bars, 135k volume is thin so the last bar is weak evidence, and the OR low (1141.4) is already broken, so a chase is late. The scanner's stop at 1150.55 is about 10 risk, and the 1120.19 target is a far 20 away.

Plan: short only on a bounce failing at VWAP, or a break under 1140.4. Stop 1146.5 (above VWAP), target 1134 (prev close area). That is about 1:1.2 at best, so marginal. I lean stay out unless volume expands on the break.

judge.title: No trade: SBIN short: right direction, weak fuel – pass
judge.text: The short case has real support. The 1150.55 opening high was rejected through lower highs (1150.55, 1150.15, 1148.25, 1143.5), and price closed at the day low of 1141.0. That is 5.2 below VWAP (1146.24), below the opening-range low (1141.4) and below yesterday's high (1142.65), with the index down 0.21%. Against it, the 6.05x relvol is front-loaded: bar volume fell from 2.8M to 2.0M, then 600k, then 135k. So the breakdown is happening on thin volume, and the first obvious support, the gap-fill to yesterday's close at 1135, is only about 5 points (under 1 ATR of 5.84) below the trigger. A stop above VWAP at 1146.5 risks about 6.1, which forces a target near 1131, beyond that 1135 magnet. Yesterday's huge 1105.7–1142.65 up-range also leaves dip buyers active. With roughly 0.25R of costs and my small sample of similar shorts split both ways (n=5), the edge looks marginal. I would only short a fresh break under 1140.4 if volume expanded, so for scoring this is NO_TRADE.

cases.headline: HINDALCO is bouncing after a gap down, but resistance just above leaves too little room to profit after costs; stay out.
cases.bull:
**Bull case, long HINDALCO (honest version):**

Price is 894.75, just 1.3 below the opening-range high of 896.05 and above VWAP of 892.13. The stock gapped down 1.3% (open 888.1 vs prev close 900) and has since held the range. Relvol of 4.76 is strong, and the 09:15 bar's 680k volume shows real participation. Four bars show higher lows after the 09:15 spike (889.0, 888.8, 891.25). The index is only -0.2%, so the stock is relatively strong at +0.75% on the day.

**Entry:** a 5-minute close above 896.05, with the scanner's 896.5 trigger acceptable.

**Stop:** the rule's 881.1 is 15.4 points away, which is far too wide, about 2.3x ATR. Better is 889.0, under the 09:20 low and VWAP, roughly 7.5 points of risk. Rs 500 would then buy about 66 shares.

**Target:** 927.29 is unrealistic intraday; it is above yesterday's high of 916.85. Realistic is about 905-908, near 1.5R. Prior-day resistance and the 20-DMA of 916.5 sit overhead.

**Wrong if:** it fails the breakout and closes below VWAP 892, or the 09:30 volume fade (223k) continues. Edge is marginal after costs.
cases.bear:
Rebuttal: The Bull's "higher lows" are weak. The lows were 881.1, 889.0, 888.8, 891.25, so the 09:25 low of 888.8 is actually below 889.0. Only one bar is clearly higher. The stock is +0.75% from the 888.1 open but still 0.58% below yesterday's 900 close, so "relative strength" is a bounce within a gap-down. Relvol of 4.76 is mostly the opening bar (680k); volume then ran 437k, 785k, 223k, and the latest bar is the weakest. The Bull concedes 927 is unreachable and that edge is marginal, which argues for no trade.

Bear case: price sits 1.3 under the OR high and has not broken it. The 20-DMA at 916.5 and yesterday's low of 898.15 are overhead, so 898-900 is a supply zone. Reward to there is only about 3-5 points against 7.5 risk. VWAP is just 2.6 below, so the stock is not stretched.

Short is not clean either. Honest stance: stay out for now. A short only triggers on a 5-minute close below 891.2, with a stop at 896.5 and a target of 883, which is about 8 points of reward against 5.3 of risk. That is roughly 1.5R before costs, so it is marginal.

judge.title: No trade: HINDALCO: OR-high breakout runs straight into gap-fill supply at 898-900
judge.text: The bull points are real. Relative volume is 4.76x, price at 894.75 sits above VWAP 892.13, and the stock is up 0.75% from its 888.1 open while the index is down 0.2%. The deciding problem is room to run. A breakout trigger at 896.5 meets yesterday's low of 898.15 and close of 900 almost at once, and the 20-DMA at 916.5 sits above that. A sensible stop under the 09:20-09:25 lows (888.8-889.0) costs about 7 points, so a 1.5R target of about 907.5 has to push through that whole supply zone. Volume has also faded to 223k in the latest bar from 680k and 785k earlier, and after costs of about 0.25R this is marginal at best. My similar-setup record is mixed and only n=4, so today's resistance map decides it: no trade, with long levels 896.5/889.5/907.5 recorded for scoring.

cases.headline: PNB is strong today but has already run a lot and stalled; skip the breakout chase.
cases.bull:
**Bull case (long PNB):** The setup is a real opening-range breakout candidate, but the plan's risk geometry needs fixing.

**Evidence:** PNB opened at 149.81 (the day low) and ran to 153.44 in two bars, up 2.24% while the index is -0.21%. That's relative strength. Relvol is 3.98, and the first three bars carried 2.5M, 3.0M and 2.8M shares. Price is 153.17, above VWAP 152.80, and above yesterday's high of 152.59. It has held within 0.27 of the high through three bars, which is a tight consolidation. 

**Entry:** Buy a 5-minute close above 153.44, or the 153.52 trigger. 

**Stop:** The plan's 149.81 stop is 3.71 away, about 2.5x ATR. At Rs 500 risk that's only ~134 shares. Better to stop at ~152.00, below the VWAP and the 152.04 pullback low. Risk is then ~1.5 per share, ~330 shares. 

**Target:** 156 is realistic, about 2R. The plan's 160.93 looks too far for one session.

**Wrong if:** price closes below VWAP 152.80, or the breakout fails and drops back under 152.04. The last bar's volume is just 0.53M, and it may not be a full bar, so I'd want volume to confirm the breakout.
cases.bear:
**Rebuttals:** Relative strength is real, but the whole 2.24% came in the first bar (149.81 to 152.63). Since then, three bars have gone nowhere: highs of 153.44, 153.34 and 153.17, closes of 153.17, 152.47 and 153.17. That is stalling, not tight consolidation. The Bull's "above yesterday's high" is just 0.58 above 152.59, so that level is barely cleared. Volume is fading: 3.03M, 2.78M, then 0.53M. The Bull concedes the last bar may be partial, which is fair, but it is also unconfirmed. The 152.00 stop sits only about 0.5 ATR from price (ATR 1.48), inside normal noise, and costs are a quarter of the risk. The 156 target needs about 2.8 of movement against a first-bar burst that has already stalled.

**Case:** The first bar opened at the low and closed near the high, and the open is the day low at 149.81. That is a classic extended opening spike, with price 0.37 above VWAP. The index is down 0.21%, so there is no market tailwind. A failed 153.44 break would trap longs.

**Short idea (low conviction):** Sell on a 5-minute close below 152.04, which is the pullback low. Stop 153.50. Target 150.80, about 1.2 of reward for 1.5 of risk. That is not good enough, so staying out is the honest call unless the breakout fails cleanly.

judge.title: No trade: PNB: strong open, stretched range, no entry
judge.text: The Bull is right about the strength. Relative volume is 3.98x, the stock is up 2.24% while the index is down 0.21%, and price at 153.17 sits above VWAP 152.80 and yesterday's high of 152.59. But the Bear's points decide it. Almost the whole move came in the first bar (149.81 to 152.63), and the next bars topped out at 153.44, 153.34 and 153.17 while volume faded from 3.03M to 0.53M. The day's range is already 3.63, about 2.5x the 1.48 ATR, so a 1.5R target at 155.80 needs roughly 4x ATR from the low with no market tailwind. The tight 152.00 stop sits about 1 ATR under the trigger, and costs eat about a quarter of the risk, so this marginal breakout is a pass; the levels shown are the long I would have taken above 153.52.

cases.headline: Bank of Baroda is climbing on heavy volume while the market dips; buy a break above 278.52 with a tight stop just under the day's average price.
cases.bull:
**Bull case (long BANKBARODA):** The stock opened at 274.18, near the prior close of 274.5 (gap -0.12%), and has driven straight up to 278.38, a 1.53% move while the index is down 0.21%. That is real relative strength. Relative volume of 3.79 shows participation, and the first two bars carried 696k and 1.10M shares. Price sits above VWAP (277.61) and has cleared yesterday's high of 275.57. The 20-day average at 251.04 puts the stock in a strong uptrend.

**Entry:** The plan's trigger is 278.52, just 0.14 above the last price and the 278.38 day high. I'd buy only if a 5-minute bar closes above it. A pullback toward VWAP at about 277.6 would be a better price, if it holds.

**Stop:** The plan's 274.84 is 3.68 away, roughly 3 ATRs, so the position would be small. A tighter stop below VWAP, around 277.0, risks about 1.5 and sizes better, but it is more exposed to noise.

**Target:** 285.88 is 7.4 away, about 6 ATRs, which is ambitious for one session. A realistic target is 280.5-281.5, roughly 1.5-2R off a tight stop.

**Wrong if:** price loses VWAP on volume, or the breakout fails and the stock falls back inside the 274.18-278.20 range. Also note that the last bar had only 88k shares, though it may be incomplete, so the breakout is unconfirmed.
cases.bear:
Rebuttals: Relative strength is real, but the move is already spent. Price is up 1.53% in four bars, and the last close of 278.38 is 0.77 above VWAP (277.61), about 0.6 ATR. Participation is fading: volume went 1.10M, 663k, then 88k. The Bull calls that last bar possibly incomplete, but it's the only evidence for the breakout and it says no follow-through. The 20-day average at 251.04 is 11% below price, which shows extension, not an entry reason. Clearing yesterday's high of 275.57 is already done and gives no edge now. The Bull's tight 277.0 stop is under one ATR from VWAP, so noise would hit it.

Case for short: It's thin. Price pokes just above the 278.20 opening range high on dying volume, which is a classic failed breakout setup. But it's only 20 minutes old, and the index is down just 0.21%, so there is no strong tailwind or headwind.

Short trigger: a 5-minute close below 277.60 (VWAP) after a failed hold above 278.2. Stop: 278.60, about 1.0 risk, which is under one ATR. Target: 275.60, near yesterday's high, about 2R.

Honest conclusion: staying out is better. Neither side has confirmation, and costs eat a marginal edge.

judge.title: BANKBARODA: relative-strength opening-range breakout, tightened stop
judge.text: The Bull's evidence carries the decision. The stock is up 1.53% from its 274.18 open while the index is down 0.21%, on 3.79x relative volume, and it sits above both VWAP (277.61) and yesterday's high (275.57). The Bear's point about fading volume is weak: the 88k on the 09:30 bar is almost certainly a partial bar, and it is still printing new highs at 278.38. Plan: the scanner's trigger of 2647.08 is only 1.3 points under the low. Its stop at 2710.9 is 63.8 points away, and the target at 2519.43 is 2x that, which is unrealistic intraday. judge.title: No trade: MUTHOOTFIN: short bias, but the drop has run and the 20-DMA caps the target

cases.headline: SBIN is drifting lower but has not broken down yet, and the setup is too thin to pay after costs, so stay out.

My trade: short on a 5-minute close below 1108.9, entry about 1108.4. Stop 1113.0, just above VWAP, which is 4.6 points of risk, about 108 shares. Target 1099, about 2R, ahead of yesterday's low. If there is no break, stay out. Without a break on rising volume, this is marginal.

judge.title: No trade: SBIN: short lean, but no clean edge at 1108.9

cases.headline: IndusInd Bank is drifting lower on heavy volume; sell only if it breaks below this morning's low.

Verdict: a conditional short only. Trigger: a 5-minute close below 920.75, entry about 920.3. Stop: 923.0, above the VWAP and the bar highs, risk about 3.3. Target: 913.7, 2:1. Otherwise, stay out.

cases.headline: Bajaj Finserv gapped down, is trading below yesterday's low, and is drifting lower; sell short only if it breaks today's low.

**Stop:** The scanner's 132.2 stop is 2.17 away, about 2.6x ATR, so Rs 500 of risk buys roughly 230 shares. That is too wide for a quick breakout. I'd use a tighter stop under 133.85 (the previous high / VWAP zone), about 0.5 risk. That cuts the cost drag to a smaller share of risk.

cases.bear:
**Rebuttal:** The Bull calls the first two bars "near the highs," but 09:25 closed at 133.94, well off its 134.3 high, and volume fell from 1.83M to 1.10M. That is fading volume on the test of the OR high. Price is below VWAP (134.071), so the "above" case is unproven. Relative volume of 1.76 comes from only three bars, one with zero volume, so it's weak evidence. The 20-day average of 122.27 is irrelevant to the next hour; the stock is 9.5% above it, which is extension, not support. The proposed stop under 133.85 is about 0.09 below price, roughly 0.1x ATR (0.83). That is noise-level, and costs of about a quarter of risk would be far worse than the Bull admits. The 2x ATR target against that stop is fantasy.

**Bear case:** The first 09:15 bar rallied 132.2 to 133.7, and the move has stalled at 134.3, with a rejection wick on 09:25 (high 134.3, close 133.94). Index is only +0.18%, so no strong tailwind.

**Short trigger:** 5-minute close below 133.80 (under the 09:25 low and just above the previous high of 133.89... so require a close below 133.80 only on rising volume).

**Stop:** 134.40, about 0.6 risk, 1.0 ATR.

**Target:** 132.90, about 1.3 ATR.

Honestly, with three bars, staying out is the better call.

judge.title: CANBK: conditional long on a break of the 134.3 opening-range high

The 09:25 bar hit 134.3 and closed at 133.94, below VWAP at 134.07, and volume fell from 1.83M to 1.10M. I use 133.6 instead, under the 09:20 low of 133.65 (0.77 risk, 0.57%), with a 135.6 target (1.6x risk). That keeps a fill from being eaten by costs, though with only three bars and my 4 past calls (n is tiny) this is a small, conditional bet.

The wide 87-point stop (1.8x ATR5) gives poor sizing, and 7947 yesterday's high caps the move.

cases.bear:

The index at +0.23% is mild support, but COALINDIA is falling against it (-1.0%), which is relative weakness. The Bull concedes price is below the 20DMA (402.85) and the open was the day high.

Bear case: open equals day high at 403.0, and price is capped below VWAP and the 20DMA, with yesterday's low (402.3) now overhead as resistance. But price is sitting 0.1 above the day low, and the range is only 4.9 points, so the move is already done and chasing is poor.

Short trigger: 5-minute close below 398.1 (the day low). The scanner's 397.9 is fine. Stop: 399.7, just above VWAP and the 09:20 high, about 1.8 risk, rather than the scanner's 403.0, which is far too wide. Target: 395.5, about 2R. Given the thin edge and costs, staying out until 398.1 breaks is preferable.

judge.title: No trade: COALINDIA: relative weakness is real, but the edge left is too thin to short
judge.text: The Bear wins on direction. Coal India is down 1.0% while the index is up 0.23%, it opened at its high of 403.0, and every bounce since (highs 399.55, 399.0, 398.95) has stalled at or below VWAP (399.065), so the Bull's long has no reclaim to stand on. Against a short, almost the whole 4.9-point opening range came in the first bar on 563k shares, and the last three bars have gone flat above 398.1, so a break below 397.9 would be chasing a move that is largely finished. A sensible stop at 399.7 risks 1.8 points, about one ATR5 (1.84), and the 395.0 target needs another 1.5 ATR of follow-through; once costs take roughly a quarter of the risk, that is a marginal edge, which by our rules is a loss. If forced to trade, it would be the short at 397.9, stop 399.7, target 395.0, but no trade is the better call.

cases.headline: Hero MotoCorp is drifting up with the market, but its first breakout try failed and buying has dried up, so stay out.
cases.bull:
The case for long is modest but real. HEROMOTOCO opened at 5399.0, gapped up 0.26% over yesterday's close of 5385.0, and has held above yesterday's high of 5393.5 all session. It sits well above its 20-day average of 5270.4. Relative volume is 1.77, and the 09:20 bar, with 25,359 shares and a 5448.5 high, shows real buying. Price is 5438.0, above VWAP at 5432.9, and the index is up 0.23%, so it is not fighting the tape. The last bar, 09:30, closed at the high of the range on thin volume of 3,528.

Entry: the scanner's trigger of 5451.22 is only 13 points over the 5438 last price and just above the opening range high of 5448.5. I would wait for a 5-minute close above 5451 rather than anticipate it.

Stop: the plan puts it at 5399.0, about 52 points away, roughly 2 ATRs (ATR5 is 25.6). That is wide, so the size is about 9 shares for Rs 500 risk. A tighter stop below VWAP, around 5420, is arguably more logical.

Target: the plan's 5555.67 is about 104 points away, which is ambitious. I would aim for about 5500 realistically.

Wrong if: price closes below VWAP (5432.9), or the 5-minute bar falls back inside the range under 5420. Note that the 09:25 bar already rejected 5447, so the edge is thin after costs.
cases.bear:
Rebuttals. The Bull's "held above yesterday's high" is true (day low 5399.0 vs 5393.5), but the margin is only 5.5 points, and price opened at the day low, so it is barely a support test. The 5448.5 high on the 09:20 bar was the opening range top, and the 09:25 bar rejected 5447.0 and closed at 5422.0. That is a failed push, not clean buying. The Bull says the last bar closed at its high, but it is on 3,528 shares against 25,359 at the peak, so the volume is down about 86%. Price is only 5.1 points above VWAP, which is a small cushion. The Bull's tighter 5420 stop is under 1 ATR (25.6), so noise will likely hit it.

Short case: weak, and I would mostly stay out. The index is up 0.23%, which argues against fighting the tape. Still, there is a double-top feel near 5447-5448.5 on fading volume.

Conditional short: trigger on a 5-minute close below 5420, which is under the 09:25 low of 5420.0 and VWAP. Stop 5449. Target 5399. That is 21 points of reward for 29 of risk, a poor ratio after costs. My recommendation is to stay out.

judge.title: No trade: HEROMOTOCO: thin breakout edge, pass
judge.text: The long case has real support: price is 5438.0, just above VWAP at 5432.9; the day low of 5399.0 is above yesterday's high of 5393.5; relative volume is 1.77; and the index is up 0.23%. Against it, the 09:20 push to 5448.5 was rejected on the 09:25 bar, which closed at 5422.0. The bounce back to 5438 came on only 3,528 shares, against 25,359 on the peak bar, so buying is fading into the range top. The scanner's stop at 5399.0 is about 52 points (roughly 2 ATR) and its 5555.67 target is ambitious, while a tighter 5420 stop sits barely more than 1 ATR (25.6) away, so either version leaves a marginal edge that costs of about a quarter of the risk would erase. If forced to trade, I would go long on a break of 5451.5 with a stop at 5420 and a target of 5499, but the failed first test and drying volume make this a pass.

cases.headline: Britannia is sitting right on its morning low; a breakdown short is possible, but the reward barely covers costs, so we stay out.
cases.bull:
Honest case for a long is thin, and I'll say so up front.

The bull argument: price is sitting at 4723.9, right on the opening-range low of 4722.0 (it was defended twice, at 09:25 and 09:30, with lows of exactly 4722.0). That's a possible double-bottom. The 20-day average is 4730.09, so price is just under it, and the index is up 0.23% while BRITANNIA is down 0.76%, which leaves room for mean reversion. Selling volume is also fading: 8110, 5569, then 2075.

Entry: only on a confirmed bounce, say a 5-minute close above 4731 (reclaiming the 20DMA). The stop goes below 4722, around 4716, so risk is about 15 points, which keeps size workable. Realistic target: VWAP at 4744.8, about 14 points above entry. That's roughly 1R before costs, and costs eat about a quarter of that.

What proves me wrong: any 5-minute close below 4722. Also, the trend is down from the 4789.5 high, price is below VWAP, and relative volume of 1.75 favors sellers. Only four bars exist, so this is a weak setup. I'd pass unless the reclaim happens.
cases.bear:
Rebuttals: The double-bottom is two bars with identical lows of 4722.0, which is thin evidence, and the last bar's range (4722.0 to 4730.9) is only 8.9 points against an ATR of 25.8. That is compression, not a reversal. Fading volume (8110, 5569, 2075) shows selling exhaustion, but it also just reflects the usual opening burst fading. The 20DMA at 4730.09 is 6 points away, which is noise. Index up 0.23% while the stock is down 0.76% shows relative weakness, not a bounce signal. The Bull's target of 4744.8 is about 1R, and costs take a quarter of that, so the edge is marginal.

Short case: the stock reversed from 4789.5 to 4723.9, closing below the open (4760.3) and VWAP (4744.8). It opened near prev_close and failed under prev_hi of 4810.

But the scanner's plan is poor. Entry 4719.64 with a stop at 4789.5 risks about 70 points. The target of 4579.92 is 140 points away, about 5 ATRs, which is unrealistic. Only four bars exist.

My trade: short on a 5-minute close below 4722, entry about 4720. Stop 4745 (VWAP), 25 points risk. Target 4695, 1R. That is marginal after costs, so staying out is acceptable.

judge.title: No trade: BRITANNIA: OR-low breakdown short is too marginal, pass
judge.text: The bear side is the better side. The stock fell from 4789.5 to 4723.9, below VWAP (4744.8), below yesterday's low (4741.2) and below its 20DMA (4730.09). It is down 0.76% while the index is up 0.23%, and relative volume is 1.75. Even so, the trade does not pay: the scanner's 70-point stop and 140-point target (about 5 five-minute ATRs of 25.8) are unrealistic. A sensible VWAP stop of about 25 points allows only a roughly 1.5R target near 4681, and costs take about a quarter of R. The 4722.0 low has also held twice, and the last bar is a compressed 8.9-point range on fading volume (8110, 5569, 2075), so the breakdown could easily fail at support with only four bars of evidence. The bull's reclaim long gives about 1R into VWAP, which is worse, so neither side clears the cost hurdle and the verdict is NO_TRADE.
